data.title: New gTLD Domain Registration Burst with Phishing Characteristics
data.description: Detect bulk domain registrations (5+ in 24h from same registrant/nameserver) on high-abuse gTLDs (.TOP, .BOND, .XYZ, .SHOP, .XIN, .CFD, .LOL) with brand-keyword presence, domain age < 7 days, and low registration cost. Interisle found 37% of phishing domains were bulk-registered and new gTLDs accounted for 51% of all phishing domains.
falsepositives: Domain portfolio investors acquiring multiple domains
Legitimate product launches registering multiple TLD variants
